summary: Old data is removed steadily without slowing the web app.

fixes.title: Old data is removed without slowing you
fixes.text: Old data is now removed almost continuously while nothing else runs, as fast as the database allows and slower when it is busy. The web app stays responsive.

fixes.title: A growing backlog is never unseen
fixes.text: When the removal would not finish before the next run, it speeds up. If it still cannot keep up, it says so and support is told.

fixes.title: The data sync always goes first
fixes.text: While the data sync or sending data out runs, nothing is removed.
